description: This file contains functions for parsing partition updates and generating various statistics related to OTA firmware packages, including block operations, payload usage, merge operations, and file extension analysis. It also includes functions for analyzing partitions based on different metrics and preparing data for visualization.

methods.name: addNumberToMap(map, key, value)
methods.description: Adds a numeric value to a map entry associated with a specific key, initializing it to zero if it does not exist.

methods.name: operatedBlockStatistics(partitions)
methods.description: Generates statistics on the number of blocks operated on in various partitions, categorized by operation types like REPLACE or BSDIFF.

methods.name: mergeOperationStatistics(partitions, blockSize)
methods.description: Compiles merge operation statistics across partitions, accounting for total blocks and handling COW_REPLACE cases.

methods.name: operatedPayloadStatistics(partitions)
methods.description: Calculates disk usage statistics of payload.bin based on operation types for given partitions.

methods.name: operatedExtensionStatistics(partitions, blockSize, targetFile)
methods.description: Analyzes and returns file extension-based disk usage statistics within partitions, involving querying a target file and distributing data lengths.

methods.name: analysePartitions(metrics, partitions, blockSize = 4096, targetFile = null)
methods.description: Performs analysis on given partitions based on specified metrics, returning visualization data suitable for charts or graphs.

methods.name: numBlocks(exts)
methods.description: Calculates total number of blocks being operated on within a list of extensions.

methods.name: displayBlocks(exts)
methods.description: Creates a string representation of block ranges in the format '(start_block, block_length)'.

methods.name: distributeExtensions(filenames, exts, length)
methods.description: Distributes a total data length across file extensions proportionally based on their block extents.

methods.name: name2Extension(filename)
methods.description: Extracts the file extension from a filename, with handling for unknown or no-extension scenarios.

ctags.name: analysePartitions
ctags.pattern: /^export async function analysePartitions(metrics, partitions, blockSize = 4096, targetFile = null/
